messages.snippet: All, The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 17 January until approximately 02:00 Sunday
messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance - document management system (Sat 17 Jan)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS will be unavailable from 20:00 on Saturday 17 January until approximately 02:00 Sunday for a scheduled upgrade. Please check in any documents you are working on before Friday close of business. Email and the time-recording system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
